card.name: Punctuation after a table number
card.fires_on: The colon or period right after a table label such as "Table 3" that starts a table title, mostly in dosing sections of drug labels. It also fires weakly on a space inside a weight range in a dosing table.

modes.label: Table title punctuation
modes.description: A colon or period directly after "Table N" where the table caption begins, following a sentence that points to the table.
modes.example: is provided in Table 1. Table 1<<:>> Recommended Oral Once Daily Dosage of SIM

modes.label: Space in weight range
modes.description: A space inside a weight band in a dosing table, just before the upper number.
modes.example: 38 kg to less than<< >>45 kg 50 mg twice

card.writes: It promotes ellipsis-like punctuation and line breaks, which suggests a pause or break in the text after the marked point.
card.plain: It marks the spot right after a table number where the table's title begins.
